																			366 heading Claude responded: The jobs-ON qualification run stopped safely, so be837974 isn't release-qualified yet.
																			367 text The jobs-ON qualification run stopped safely, so be837974 isn’t release-qualified yet. Nothing is needed from YY. The jobs-OFF half passed in full and memory stayed clean (0 OOM).
																			368 text What stopped it:
																			369 text after the first natural Kobo sync (174 new samples, 22 skipped), an existing Sample row in the copy had changed, and the verifier refuses any change to an original row. My best guess, which isn’t confirmed yet, is the Kobo duplicate-barcode handling, which is unchanged from the version running in production. When a new submission reuses the barcode of an existing expected sample, the sync adds a conflict note to that sample and puts it on hold. The verifier was built when there were no new submissions, so it had never seen that happen.
